method: each breach replaces a function the running system calls and each detector observes a behaviour, never source text

breaches.name: effectivity_bypass
breaches.guarantee: ADR-001 A: an as-of query never returns a superseded chunk
breaches.mechanism: candidate_filter replaced by one that builds the predicate with the effectivity clauses omitted
breaches.detector: the withdrawn chunk's membership of the candidate set

breaches.name: wrong_variant
breaches.guarantee: ADR-001 B: an as-of query never returns another variant's chunk
breaches.mechanism: the variant and serial terms removed from the candidate predicate
breaches.detector: count of returned chunks belonging to a variant other than the one asked

breaches.name: stale_revision_off_by_one
breaches.guarantee: the validity interval is half-open, so a withdrawal date belongs to one revision
breaches.detector: distinct revisions admitted on the exact day of a withdrawal

breaches.name: bitemporal_knowledge_time
breaches.guarantee: a later correction does not rewrite the answer to a historical knowledge query
breaches.mechanism: the knowledge-time predicate replaced by TRUE
breaches.detector: whether a correction issued after the asked knowledge date became a candidate
breaches.baseline: correction visible at an earlier knowledge date: False
breaches.breached: correction visible at an earlier knowledge date: True

breaches.name: pgvector_bypass
breaches.guarantee: ADR-001 K: vector retrieval executes inside PostgreSQL
breaches.mechanism: the pgvector distance ranking replaced by an in-process sort over the same filtered candidates, which returns a near-identical ranking
breaches.detector: the executed query plan, read back from PostgreSQL

breaches.name: unsupported_answer
breaches.guarantee: ADR-001 E: the gate never answers a question the corpus cannot support
breaches.mechanism: gate.decide replaced by one that returns ANSWER whatever the rules concluded
breaches.detector: the outcome for a question naming a product that is not in the corpus

breaches.name: wrong_citation
breaches.guarantee: ADR-001 D: every cited span appears in the document it is attributed to
breaches.mechanism: the citation's quote replaced by text absent from the source document, with its offsets left untouched
breaches.detector: verify_citation, which locates the span in the source by offset

breaches.name: missing_disclosure
breaches.guarantee: Article 50: every response carries a machine-generated disclosure
breaches.mechanism: an Answer constructed with an empty ai_disclosure

breaches.name: incremental_index_skip
breaches.guarantee: changed chunks are re-embedded; unchanged chunks are not
breaches.mechanism: loader._needs_embedding replaced by one that always answers False, so a chunk whose text changed is never re-embedded
breaches.detector: measure_index_lifecycle's count of chunks the loader actually re-embedded after their text was changed

breaches.name: split_leak
breaches.guarantee: ADR-001 L: no document appears in both splits
breaches.mechanism: one hold-out question relabelled as development while still citing its hold-out evidence
breaches.detector: the partition check, resolving question -> chunk -> document -> family
